verdict: On these packets, page images alone did best. Classifying page by page with Amazon Nova 2 Lite, images alone gave more pages the right class (0.84, against 0.82 with text and images) and got more sections exactly right (0.57, against 0.50), with 25% fewer classification tokens. Text alone scored lowest (0.79 and 0.46). DocSplit's pages are scans with noisy OCR text; on clean digital documents the text may count for more, so test on your own files before you turn it off.
